device.modelDescription: a long-running action whose handler asks its user a declared question from inside a task (MCP completeness M22)

actionList.name: probe
actionList.description: Asks whether to do a thing, and says what came of asking.

actionList.name: peek
actionList.description: Reads, then tries to write, a key named for a task's question through ctx.redis, and says what it saw.
